title: Set
description: A file in data/set/, one set per file, such as data/set/mh3.json. The identity and the English values of one product. Corrections do not attach to sets.

set_code.description: The official code of the product, such as MH3. Directory names go lowercase around it.

name.description: The name of the set in English.

released_at.description: The day the set was released.
